symbolic-regression benchmark. You are given a CURRENT governing equation and
must produce a MORE COMPLEX successor equation.

ORIGINAL PHENOMENON CONTEXT:
A small free-surface displacement in a long channel evolves as a damped standing wave. The benchmark jointly evolves the surface displacement and its associated depth-averaged velocity, with gravity and channel geometry held fixed. Pressure restoring motion produces repeated sign changes, while viscosity removes mechanical energy over time. Wave breaking, external forcing, and lateral modes are absent from the baseline system.

CURRENT EQUATION:
  du_dt = -gravity * wavenumber * eta * (1 + finite_amplitude_stiffening * eta**2) - linear_damping_rate * u - quadratic_damping_rate * u * Abs(u) / (velocity_transition_scale + Abs(u))

  t [V] — Time, in seconds
  eta [S] — Free-surface displacement amplitude of the retained standing-wave mode, in metres
  u [S] — Depth-averaged velocity amplitude of the retained standing-wave mode, in metres per second
  gravity [P] — Gravitational acceleration, in metres per square second
  wavenumber [P] — Standing-wave mode wavenumber, in inverse metres
  linear_damping_rate [P] — Linear viscous damping rate, in inverse seconds
  quadratic_damping_rate [P] — Amplitude-dependent drag coefficient setting the strength of the nonlinear damping contribution, in inverse seconds
  velocity_transition_scale [P] — Velocity scale at which the additional damping transitions from weak to strong activation, in metres per second
  finite_amplitude_stiffening [P] — Coefficient of the weak finite-amplitude correction to the restoring stiffness, in inverse square metres | suggested range: nonnegative and small enough that finite_amplitude_stiffening * eta**2 is order 1 or smaller over observed non-breaking amplitudes; typically positive for hardening restoration

MODEL FAMILY: ode

Before selecting the one refinement to return, screen possible refinements for:
(a) constant renaming or merging, e.g. k*x -> (k+a)*x with fixed k and a;
(b) algebraic cancellation, an identically zero contribution, or a branch that
cannot activate under the scenario's admissible conditions;

(d) a correction expected to be negligible throughout the admissible domain;
(e) only changing auxiliary trajectories while leaving the scored mapping from
supplied observations unchanged, e.g. making dv/dt complex when scoring dx/dt=v

these applies. Do not select a redundant change just to fill a generation slot.

response relationship, e.g. temperature-dependent stiffness with varying T;
parameter changes are not forbidden as a category.

- parameter_to_state: an EXISTING P symbol itself becomes S with its own RHS
